title: Kernel Module Monitor
excerpt: A lightweight monitor for custom Linux kernel modules with real-time memory tracking and deadlock detection.

content.text: This project explores observability for custom kernel modules without adding significant runtime overhead.
The monitor collects memory and locking signals, then presents them in a compact terminal interface suitable for development and debugging.
Its main design constraint is predictable cost: instrumentation should help diagnose a module without becoming the source of new timing problems.
